settings.models_heading: Rovelo models we install in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
Rovelo is the budget brand we reach for when you want a fair, honest price and don't want to gamble on a no-name tire. It's a real brand built to international DOT and ECE safety standards, priced well below Michelin or Bridgestone — strong value-per-km for Calgary commuters, second cars, and high-mileage drivers shopping affordable tires in Calgary.

The all-season lineup (RHP-780P, Sport A1) covers daily driving on Deerfoot, Glenmore, and Macleod Trail through spring, summer, and fall. M+S rated, quiet, and built for the mixed city-and-highway driving most Calgary drivers actually do.

For winter, the RWS-677 carries the 3PMSF mountain-snowflake symbol — it meets Alberta's winter-tire expectations and the Highway 93 / Trans-Canada Banff mandate, with a studdable option for black ice on NE and SE side streets. (Rovelo's current Canadian winter lineup may also be branded Arctic Vision — ask us which is in stock.) The Ridgetrak A/T covers light trucks and SUVs.

Whatever you run, every Rovelo we fit gets the same balance, calibrated torque, TPMS reset, and free re-torque as a premium install. Book installation or call (403) 452-4283.

settings.calgary_richtext: We're one of the few tire shops in SW Calgary — easy to reach from Mission, Erlton, Manchester, Britannia, Bankview, and Mount Royal, right off Macleod Trail. Rovelo is our go-to budget fit for SW drivers who want winter compliance and all-season value without premium pricing. The RWS-677 (3PMSF, studdable) handles packed snow and the freeze-thaw chinook swings; the Ridgetrak A/T covers light trucks and SUVs heading out to the gravel roads east of the city. Family-owned since 2021, 4.9★ from 562+ Calgary drivers.
settings.faq_1_a: For a budget tire, yes. Rovelo is a real brand built to international DOT and ECE safety standards, not an unbranded import. We install them to the same balance, calibrated torque, and TPMS-reset standard as a premium tire and stand behind every set. For strict-budget shopping, second cars, and high-mileage drivers they're a sensible pick — and we'll tell you honestly when a premium tire is worth the extra spend instead.
settings.faq_2_a: Rovelo is manufactured by Shandong Linglong Tyre in China, one of the world's larger tire makers that also supplies original-equipment and aftermarket tires globally. Buying a budget brand from a major factory is generally a safer bet than an unbranded no-name tire.
settings.faq_3_q: How much do Rovelo tires cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_3_a: Rovelo is one of the most affordable brands we install — typically well below premium brands like Michelin or Bridgestone in the same size. Exact pricing depends on your size and the current model in stock, and we back it with our price-match guarantee. Call (403) 452-4283 for a quote on your size.
settings.faq_4_q: Are Rovelo winter tires good for Calgary winters?
settings.faq_4_a: Rovelo's winter tire, the RWS-677, carries the 3PMSF mountain-snowflake symbol, so it meets Alberta's winter-tire expectations and the Highway 93 / Trans-Canada Banff mandate. It comes in a studdable version for extra grip on NE and SE black ice. Rovelo's current Canadian winter lineup may also be sold under the Arctic Vision name — call us to confirm which model and sizes are in stock before you book.
settings.faq_5_q: Do you install Rovelo tires in Calgary?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes. We fit Rovelo at our shop at 111 42 Ave SW in SW Calgary — mounting, balancing, TPMS reset, and a free re-torque, the same install standard as any premium tire. Book online or call (403) 452-4283 to confirm sizing and availability.
settings.faq_6_q: What warranty do Rovelo tires have?
settings.faq_6_a: Rovelo tires carry a standard manufacturer treadwear and defect warranty that varies by model. Prince Tires processes any warranty claim directly on your behalf, the same way we do for Michelin or Bridgestone. Call us for the exact terms on the model and size you're considering.
